Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator extracted an incomplete subset of countries from a high-level Wikipedia summary and treated it as exhaustive, listing only Brunei, Saudi Arabia, Japan, Thailand, and Bahrain. This ignored several Asian monarchies with coastlines (e.g., Cambodia, Jordan, Kuwait, Malaysia, Oman, Qatar, UAE). By not verifying against the full Wikipedia list, the Orchestrator undercounted and concluded “5” instead of the correct higher number.
